**Model fit ladder (corrected data): paired comparison of eighteen fitted models against the random-intercepts baseline (28,655 obs / 1,450 respondents)**

elpd_diff and se_diff are the *paired* expected log predictive density difference and its standard error relative to the random-intercepts baseline (Model 1), computed from each model's per-observation elpd_waic. The ratio column (elpd_diff / se_diff) is a rough guide only: |ratio| > ~2 is suggestive, not proof, that a comparison exceeds sampling noise. The crossed-slopes column names which exposure carries a genre-level random slope and in which equation; every model also has respondent and genre random intercepts.
